snapshots.name: Jim
snapshots.subtitle: The innkeeper's son who narrates the voyage
snapshots.body: A boy helping his mother run the Admiral Benbow inn when a strange old seaman takes a room and changes his life. His account of the search for buried treasure that follows is told entirely in his own words.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Billy Bones
snapshots.subtitle: An old sailor lodging at the Admiral Benbow
snapshots.body: Gruff, hard-drinking, and clearly hiding from someone, he pays Jim to watch for a one-legged seafaring man and keeps a mysterious locked chest in his room. His past catches up with him not long after he arrives.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Black Dog
snapshots.subtitle: One of Billy Bones's old shipmates
snapshots.body: A pale, unpleasant visitor missing two fingers, who tracks the captain down at the inn and comes to a violent parting with him. His arrival is the first sign that Billy Bones's past has found him.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Pew
snapshots.subtitle: A blind beggar with a fearsome reputation
snapshots.body: He arrives at the inn tapping his stick and delivers the captain a folded paper marked with the black spot, a pirate summons that terrifies Billy Bones outright. His blindness makes him no less dangerous to those who cross him.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Dr. Livesey
snapshots.subtitle: The local doctor and magistrate
snapshots.body: Level-headed and respected in the district, he treats Billy Bones and later takes a close interest in the chest the old sailor leaves behind. He becomes one of the small party that sets out after the treasure.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Squire Trelawney
snapshots.subtitle: A wealthy, talkative local landowner
snapshots.body: Enthusiastic and none too discreet, he finances and provisions the expedition to find the treasure once he learns of the map. His loose talk while hiring the crew has consequences none of them foresee.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Long John Silver
snapshots.subtitle: A one-legged ship's cook hired for the voyage
snapshots.body: Affable, quick-witted, and missing a leg from an old injury, he is taken on as cook for the Hispaniola on the squire's recommendation. Jim likes him from the start, which turns out to matter a great deal later.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Captain Smollett
snapshots.subtitle: The Hispaniola's hired captain
snapshots.body: Strict and uneasy about the whole voyage from the start, he distrusts the loose talk aboard ship and the crew the squire has assembled. His caution proves better founded than anyone wants to admit.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Israel Hands
snapshots.subtitle: The Hispaniola's coxswain
snapshots.body: A seasoned, dangerous sailor among the hands taken on for the voyage, more capable and more ruthless than most of his shipmates. Jim finds himself alone with him aboard ship at a critical moment.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Ben Gunn
snapshots.subtitle: A marooned sailor living alone on the island
snapshots.body: Left behind years earlier by a former crew, he has survived alone on the island ever since and knows more about its buried secrets than anyone still aboard the Hispaniola. Jim stumbles on him quite by accident.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: George Merry
snapshots.subtitle: A discontented member of the crew
snapshots.body: One of the hands most ready to voice complaints and press for a larger share once the mutiny is under way. He is not shy about challenging Silver's authority when it suits him.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Redruth
snapshots.subtitle: The squire's old gamekeeper
snapshots.body: Loyal to the squire above all else, he joins the expedition as one of the few hands the party can fully trust. His steady presence matters once the loyal men are badly outnumbered.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Captain Flint
snapshots.subtitle: The notorious pirate who buried the treasure
snapshots.body: Long dead by the time the story opens, his name and his old ship's parrot still hang over the whole voyage. Billy Bones's map, and the fear it inspires in his old crew, are all that remain of him.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.
